sources.content: CLAUDE.md for Ambrelt. Ambrelt is a schema migration tool for PostgreSQL, written in Rust. Build with cargo build and the release flag. Run tests with cargo test; the database tests need a local PostgreSQL 16 server on port 5433, started with docker compose up -d db. Migrations used in tests live in tests/fixtures/migrations. The CLI entry point is src/main.rs, and the planner that orders migrations is in src/planner/. The minimum supported Rust version is 1.78.

Rules: never change a migration file after it has been released; add a new one instead. Migration file names start with a UTC timestamp in the form YYYYMMDDHHMMSS. Every public function needs a doc comment. Run cargo fmt and cargo clippy before committing; CI rejects any clippy warning. Do not add a new crate dependency without opening an issue first. The lock timeout for migrations defaults to 5 seconds. Keep commit messages under 72 characters per line.

claims.text: Ambrelt database tests need PostgreSQL 16 on port 5432.
Ambrelt migration file names start with a UTC timestamp.
The Ambrelt migration planner is in src/planner/.
Ambrelt CI rejects any clippy warning.
The Ambrelt migration lock timeout defaults to 30 seconds.
